objective: QA round 3 of 3 (final) for Milestone 3: confirm F-M3-2 is fixed by the body-clearance pass without new visual artifacts, and re-confirm the whole milestone at the delivered tree.

projectContext.query: 3D playable game avatar locomotion animation canvas hero transition talking avatar gestures projects skills contact

acceptanceCriteria: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test and npm run build were each run by QA on Node 22 with exit codes explicitly captured (build in a copy of the tree), output tails recorded (541 tests or more; / route First Load JS within 2 kB of 125 kB), and the diff since round 2 is only the four files named in report 29.

F-M3-2 is confirmed fixed on the production build: QA's hedge.mjs lab-side-l-inner scenario and at least five other wall and prop scenarios QA chooses (including exhibit stands, kiosks, benches and planters, not only walls) show head, neck, chest and hips outside every non-ground solid on every frame across 4 runs each, including hard-landing crouches, and the new body-clearance tests fail with the pass disabled in a temp copy.

The body-clearance push creates no new visible artifact: in screencasts of wall and prop landings, wall hugs and walking along walls, the avatar never visibly slides, snaps or teleports, the feet stay planted with no skating beyond the walk and run clips' own, the avatar stays on its shadow and never floats or sinks, it never penetrates the exhibit stands, kiosks or other props it is pushed toward, and in open ground the animation is unchanged; QA judges this by eye and by per-frame root offset and foot height traces, with screenshots.

Everything approved in round 2 still holds: camera pocket sweeps at the tower passage, outer Lab wall and three more walls with 0 frames inside, below ground, inside the avatar or with head or torso hidden; hedges, lamps, Experience panel and hair; entry warm and cold with no hero freeze over 50 ms; rAF p95 under 17.5 ms with no frame over 25 ms at 1440x900 and 1920x1080; Exit pixel-exact with focus on Play; loading, pause, failures and a 10 plus 5 cycle run with identical listener and DOM counts.

No evidence or scratch file is written under .company/ or anywhere in the repository, and every finding is reported with file, line, severity, trigger, consequence, evidence and rule; the verdict is approved only if every criterion above passed.
constraints: Work only inside the isolated worktree path supplied in the delegation prompt; scope every command to it; do not edit implementation files; never run git stash, reset or checkout.
